contexts.text: He sent forth a raven, and it went forth in going and returning () = that Falsities still made disturbance. Explained.
That a raven = Falsities... gross and dense, because of their black colour. Illustrated.
The raven, etc. () = kinds of falsity which come forth when the Divine truths in the Word are made of no account.
It would be easier to make a raven white.
How it may be confirmed that a raven is white. CL 233:4. TCR 334:5. AE 824:2.
Like ravens to a carcase. SE 4337:end.

The sons of a raven () = natural men who are in darksome lumen from fallacies; as has been the case with many of the gentiles; and therefore it is said that He gives to the sons of a raven which cry [to Him].
Ravens, when mentioned in the Word, = one of the many kinds of falsities.
